text:
ravi: Heads-up I'm in Toronto (Queen St West) Tues lunch need quick spots that can do 4 ppl, not too touristy.
ella: Fat Pasha is solid for Mediterranean small plates, usually has space.
matt: Seven Lives for tacos if you want fast and casual but a line possible.
june: Maker Pizza on Queen has great slices and GF option.avi: Any good vegetarian-friendly recs?
ella: Planta for veg-forward sit-down, pricier but quiet.
matt: For cheap & quick veg: Kupfert & Kim (bowl place) on Queen.
ravi: Budget is flexible. Also need somewhere that can take one nut allergy.
june: Call ahead if you pick Fat Pasha or Planta; they note allergies. Kupfert & Kim does nut-free bowls usually.
order-bot: Poll created React with :pizza: for Maker, :burrito: for Seven Lives, :leafy_green: for Planta, :bowl_with_spoon: for Kupfert & Kim.
matt: :burrito:
ella: :leafy_green:
june: :pizza:
ravi: :leafy_green: (leaning quieter for client chat)
ella: Votes look Planta > Maker > Seven Lives > Kupfert. If you want quieter and allergy-friendly, Planta wins.
ravi: Thanks I'll try to reserve Planta for 12:30 and post confirmation.
